notes.title: Version 1.1 Live
notes.content:
After weeks of messing with code and learning optimization I've got GutBuster v1.1 ready. 

Here's what's added:
[list]
[*]Optimized performance to run better on lower-powered devices. Bugs and memory leaks should be taken care of. Game should run faster.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Option added to toggle visible hitboxes for the player, targets and bullets to assist with clarity.
[*]3D food model animations have been tweaked and rotated to more accurately display the width of the target.
[*]Stage backgrounds have been altered to have deeper colors for better contrast.
[*]Cutscene Replay Button added to the between-level menu. Now you can rewatch the scene if you missed it!
[*]Tips On/Off Switch added to the menu, giving you the ability to turn the random tip scenes on and off.
[/list]

[b]Updates to Theater Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]All of the sections in the Theater Mode have been updated to be used with buttons, and can be operated via keyboard, mouse, or controller. No more awkward cycling through the galleries one at a time!
[*]Gallery now has a thumbnail list for easier browsing.
[*]New art added to Art Gallery, including art that must be unlocked via completing achievements.
[*]Music Test now has a selection list.
[*]Cutscene Player has three selection lists for Winning scenes, Losing scenes, and Tip Scenes. You can stop a playing scene by selecting/opening one of the lists.
[*]Effects Animations and 3D Model galleries have button lists.
[/list]


I'm a little nervous posting this update because, while there doesn't seem to be a lot changed, I altered a lot of things. I'm just hoping this doesn't break anyone's saves or anything. I've been reading your all the posts from those of you dealing with frequent crashes, seemingly from whenever the player takes a hit. (I just hope I don't have to roll it back to v1.0.3 or anything). 

If you come across any new issues, or if some previous issues are better with this new version, leaving feedback for it will be greatly appreciated! 
-RJS

notes.title: v1.0.2 Notes
notes.content:
Another li'l patch, thanks to everyone who brought more bugs to my attention. A lot of them involve Secret Achievements, so they'll be blanked out. 

[list]
[*]Created a failsafe function on game start that checks if any in-app achievements that were already activated, but the Steam Achievement wasn't, and activates the achievement. So if any Steam achievements didn't go off for you if the in-app one did, get the update and restart the game and you will get the Steam achievement right away.
[*]Updated the in-app achievements list with a "Back to Title" button and it can now be browsed via keyboard or controller. Also changed the hint for one of the Secret Achievements for something a little less obtuse, plus update the description for said achievement to accurately describe the change made in v1.0.1.
[*]Fixed a Secret Achievement bug where [spoiler]if you got the "Game of Chicken" achievement with an enzyme instead of a food target,[/spoiler] it would activate the in-app achievement, but not the Steam one. This should work properly now. If this happened to you, the failsafe should give you the achievement if you get the update and start the game. 
[*]Adjusted the Shopkeeper reactions so that [spoiler]trying to buy something that you can't afford, buying something that's sold out, and leaving her idle will count towards the "Karen" achievement instead of just poking her.[/spoiler]
[*]Updated the scientist tips: corrected one where it misstated that the Cell Wall does "four" times the damage (it's actually three), and updated another one to show the other methods to [spoiler]poke the Shopkeeper[/spoiler] by pressing the Right Stick (R3) or the "P" key.
[/list]

notes.title: First patch (v1.0.1)
notes.content:
​Hey everyone! RJS here.  Thanks for playing my completed* game! I had some bugs pointed out to me though so I (hopefully) got them fixed. Be sure to get your updated versions, as we are now at v1.0.1!​
[list]
[*]Fixed the shop bug where you would try to buy an item you couldn't afford, and getting it anyway, but only up to a certain level.
[*]Fixed the shop bug where the description box for Metabolism wouldn't appear.
[*]Updated the shop so that the description box updates to the correct numbers without having to select the item again.
[*]Fixed the bug where the Tutorial and Opening cutscene ignore the Master Volume settings.
[*]Adjusted the requirement of a certain Secret Achievement, to make it a little easier.
[/list]
-RJS
